urls.title: Page urls
urls.description: One page url per line. Every page is opened in a real Chromium and audited once. A line that is not a url comes back as its own free row with the reason, and a url that repeats is free as well.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: The list is cut here, and urls beyond the limit come back free with status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT. 0 means the default of 10, and the summary reports the number actually applied.

strategy.title: Device
enumTitles: Mobile: 412 px viewport, phone user agent
Desktop: 1440 px viewport, desktop user agent
strategy.description: mobile uses a phone viewport and user agent, which is what a search engine mostly indexes; desktop uses a 1440 px window. The row says which profile was used, so two audits are only comparable on the same profile.

settleSecs.title: Settle seconds after load
settleSecs.description: How long the page keeps running after the load event before the signals are read. Content that arrives from a timer rather than a request lands in this window; 0 reads immediately after load.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout, seconds
pageTimeoutSecs.description: A page that does not finish loading in this many seconds comes back free with status NOT_CHECKED_TIMEOUT. Raising it costs run time, not money.

ignoreHttpsErrors.title: Ignore HTTPS certificate errors
ignoreHttpsErrors.description: Turn this on only for a staging site with a self signed certificate. Every other run checks the certificate normally.
